name: Persee+
summary: Persee+ is a legacy smart camera combining structured-light RGB-D sensing with an Amlogic A311D computer. Its onboard processing supports intelligent vision applications, including explicitly documented robot perception. It is distinct from Persee 2 and the Jetson-based Persee N1. Marketing ended in September 2025.
